title: Six creative genre script mechanisms
source: User-pasted genre analysis based on brand benchmarks
source_verification: No individual video or timecodes provided; these are conceptual frameworks, not observed video evidence

principles.name: Inconvenient Law
principles.mechanism: Treat a functional product property as an unbreakable physical law; let the human inconvenience generate the joke
principles.structure: Ordinary setting → stress test → impossible durability → deadpan acceptance
principles.instruction: Write visual irony and delayed reactions; do not have characters explain the joke
principles.caution: Avoid misleading literal claims about financial products; hyperbole must be recognisably fictional

principles.name: Authority Subversion
principles.mechanism: Place a credible or high-status persona in an incongruous, self-aware situation
principles.structure: Status established → incongruous claim → sarcastic reversal → anti-climactic punchline
principles.instruction: Write crisp banter with controlled tonal contrast and a final concise reversal
principles.caution: Celebrity casting is optional; don't assume sarcasm suits trust-sensitive financial communications

principles.name: Inverse Value
principles.mechanism: Reframe a category's apparent negative as a sign of admirable human behaviour
principles.structure: Altruistic act → apparent cost/mess → motive understood → emotional brand meaning
principles.instruction: Use concrete action, reactions and silence to reveal the reframe rather than a moralising speech
principles.caution: Never trivialise genuine financial risk, debt or hardship

principles.name: Retroactive Clarity
principles.mechanism: Design the payoff first and plant earlier clues that gain meaning at the reveal
principles.structure: Intriguing scene → plausible false interpretation → unobtrusive clues → recontextualising product reveal
principles.instruction: Back-solve the setup from a visual payoff; verify the twist stays understandable on first viewing
principles.caution: Avoid withholding the core product benefit so long that a 20-second ad loses comprehension

principles.name: Invisible Tech
principles.mechanism: Dramatise the human change made possible by a digital feature rather than listing the feature
principles.structure: Human obstacle → relational stakes → simple feature action → emotional consequence
principles.instruction: Write product interaction as a short credible action beat followed by observable human payoff
principles.caution: Show enough of the actual feature to establish message comprehension

principles.name: Friction-to-Flow
principles.mechanism: Make time, paperwork or uncertainty the obstacle, with product action resolving a specific real-life impediment
principles.structure: Concrete money-related friction → rising social/time pressure → product action → visible relief
principles.instruction: Translate jargon into concrete action verbs; keep claims precise and demonstrable
principles.caution: Do not imply instant processing or guaranteed outcomes unless the product supports them
